summary: An inspired range of minimalist bathroom furnishings including bench mounted basins, rimless toilets and freestanding baths marked by the collection's signature floating aesthetic.
title: Meet Our New Flagship Range - Collection Organic
bodyHtml:
The Elegance of Minimalism,
Reimagined.

We are excited to unveil an inspired range of minimalist bathroom furnishings including bench mount and wall hung basins, rimless toilets and freestanding baths, marked by the Collection's cohesive and signature 'floating aesthetic'.

Discover Collection Organic

Our Signature Floating Aesthetic

A distinctive yet simple illusion of weightlessness, as if the pieces are floating, achieved through soft contours above a subtle skirt.

This aesthetic harmony weaves seamlessly throughout the entire collection, creating a serene and cohesive experience for the contemporary bathroom.

The Nur 80x Plan

Milady Rimless Back to Wall Suite

The Nur Freestanding Bath - Crafted in MarmoTech

A Cohesive, Contemporary Design Experience

Our Organic Basin range integrates perfectly with our Milady toilet series and selection of Freestanding baths, creating an effortless design narrative enhanced by tactile colour options like Matte White and Matte Black.

Together they define a harmonious and sophisticated bathware experience.

The Nur 90 Wall Hung Basin

Explore the Whole Collection

This edition of our catalog marks a significant shift in how we present our products. Discover thoughtfully curated sets that bring together essential bathroom components—basins, toilets, baths, and in-wall cisterns.
